comparison.objective: Swipe a magnetic-stripe card through a reader in one valid pass.
comparison.physical_skill: Card orientation, slot insertion, continuous constrained translation, and speed regulation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct stripe orientation and a complete uninterrupted swipe within the accepted speed range.
comparison.reason: Shared constrained sliding is only a generic primitive. Card swiping does not require bimanual butt-joint maintenance, load-bearing profile continuity, regrasping, or containment of free elements.
